sectionsUsed: SLF4J user manual: obtaining a Logger with LoggerFactory.getLogger; parameterized messages with {} placeholders; debug and info calls in the typical usage example. Formatting, the INFO default threshold of slf4j-simple and stack-trace output were observed with SLF4J 2.0.17 and slf4j-simple 2.0.17 on OpenJDK 25.0.4.1.

SLF4J FAQ: the TRACE level and the per-level Logger methods; an exception passed as the last argument of a logging call is treated as an exception and its stack trace is printed, while one that is not the last argument is treated as a plain object.

OWASP Logging Cheat Sheet, Data to exclude: session identification values, access tokens, authentication passwords, bank account or payment card holder data and similar should usually not be recorded directly in logs.
